content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Digital creators in Ghana and other restricted countries can start building their sovereign commerce infrastructure today. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, creators can deploy a functional online store with automatic crypto payment processing. This setup enables them to receive payments in various cryptocurrencies, giving them a competitive edge in the global market. With the right tools and guidance, creators can have a fully operational store up and running within 48 hours.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack for a sovereign commerce infrastructure includes a hosting platform, backend logic, and a payment processing system. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages can serve as the hosting platform, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic. For payment processing, NOWPayments offers a reliable solution with support for over 300 cryptocurrencies and a low transaction fee of 0.5%. This stack provides a solid foundation for creators to build upon and expand their online store as needed.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

When setting up a sovereign commerce infrastructure, it's essential to focus on the critical components that enable payment processing and product delivery. Creators can skip unnecessary steps, such as designing a custom website or developing a complex backend system, and instead use pre-built templates and existing infrastructure. By doing so, they can quickly deploy a functional store and start selling products, generating revenue, and refining their setup as needed.
Deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure today.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get the first transaction live, creators need to integrate their online store with a payment processing system like NOWPayments. This involves generating an API key, configuring the payment gateway, and testing the transaction flow. With the Complete Builder Kit, creators can access pre-built templates and guidance to streamline this process. By following the instructions and using the provided tools, creators can ensure a smooth and efficient transaction experience for their customers.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, digital creators can take concrete steps to set up their sovereign commerce infrastructure. They can start by choosing a hosting platform, setting up backend logic, and integrating a payment processing system. Additionally, they can select a pre-built template from the Complete Builder Kit and customize it to fit their brand and product offerings. By taking action and following the provided guidance, creators can quickly deploy a functional online store and start selling products to a global audience.
